question: How do the airlines rank by total ticket revenue?
mdx:
-- Operation: Rank (Airline)
-- Question: How do the airlines rank by total ticket revenue?
-- Measure: Total Price
-- Answer key: mdx/answers/05_rank_1.sql
-- RANK over the airlines ordered by revenue; the third argument makes tied airlines share a rank (as SQL RANK).
WITH SET [Ranked Airlines] AS
  ORDER(NONEMPTY([Flight].[Airline Flight].[Airline].Members, [Measures].[Total Price]), [Measures].[Total Price], BDESC)
MEMBER [Measures].[Value] AS [Measures].[Total Price]
MEMBER [Measures].[Rank] AS RANK([Flight].[Airline Flight].CurrentMember, [Ranked Airlines], [Measures].[Total Price])
SELECT {[Measures].[Rank], [Measures].[Value]} ON COLUMNS,
  [Ranked Airlines] ON ROWS
FROM [FlightCube]
answer_sql:
-- Operation: Rank (Airline)
-- Question: How do the airlines rank by total ticket revenue?
-- Measure: Total Price
-- Ties: tied members share a rank (SQL RANK)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(f.Price) DESC) AS [Rank],
       al.AirlineName AS Member,
       SUM(f.Price) AS Value
FROM dw.Fact_FlightSegment AS f
JOIN dw.DimTicket AS t ON t.TicketKey = f.TicketKey
JOIN dw.DimAirline AS al ON al.AirlineKey = t.AirlineKey
GROUP BY al.AirlineKey, al.AirlineName
ORDER BY [Rank], Member;
